description: This source file defines the 'Edit' feature for user profile updates in a web application. It includes classes for user data encapsulation, command validation, and handling the update operation, which interacts with the database context, applies hashing for passwords, and maps data for response envelope.

classes.name: Edit.UserData
classes.description: Represents user input data for profile editing, including username, email, password, bio, and image.

classes.name: Edit.Command
classes.description: Encapsulates the command to edit a user profile, holding user data and implementing IRequest for MediatR pattern.

classes.name: Edit.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the Command object, ensuring the User property is not null.

classes.name: Edit.Handler
classes.description: Processes the user profile update request, interacts with database context, hashes passwords if provided, and returns an updated user envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the process of updating the user profile, including fetching current user, updating fields, hashing password if needed, and saving changes.
